get.description: Whether the resource has stored credentials: fingerprint, when added, last use and last error.

put.description:
Test the credentials with one provider call, then seal and store them, replacing any (policy 02 access rule 15.3).

`422 credentials-rejected` when the provider refuses them; `503 credentials-unavailable`
without a KEK.

post.description: One provider call with the credentials sent; nothing is stored or retained.

Store evidence files and detect them; `add_evidence` with a file's `digest` attaches it (contract rule 9).

Each file carries its `detection`: the export type, rows and period it covers, and
`recognised`, `duplicate`, `unrecognised` (with the reason) or `too_large` (over the per-file
limit, not stored). The same bytes give the same digest and store nothing new. Each part's
file name is kept as a base name only; nothing is read from or written to a path the caller
chooses.

files.description: Evidence files; each part’s file name (a base name) is kept.

parser.description: `VENUE/PARSER` to detect every uploaded file with.

`none_uploaded`, `starts_later`, `no_rows`, `balance_mismatch`.
Every venue with an onboarding guide: name, credential fields (or `null` for exports only), guidance and export types.

AddEvidence.title: AddEvidence
AddEvidence.description:
Attach a file `POST …/uploads` stored to the resource (contract rule 9.2).

A digest already attached changes nothing, unless `parser` selects another parser for it.

AddSpec.title: AddSpec
AddSpec.description: Add an override spec to this resource: a venue-file fragment in YAML (cex unit venue specs Rule 10).

AgentMark-Input.title: AgentMark
AgentMark-Input.description: The AI agent whose API key made an edit (contract rule 7.5; policy 02 access Rule 12.11); only ever taken from the credential.

AgentMark-Output.title: AgentMark
AgentMark-Output.description: The AI agent whose API key made an edit (contract rule 7.5; policy 02 access Rule 12.11); only ever taken from the credential.

Balance.title: Balance
Balance.description:
A ledger balance: the sum of the legs of one non-perpetual asset (rule 46.1).

A perpetual's legs sum to its position's `size`, which is served in `positions` with the
`instrument` (rule 34.1); balances hold `asset`, `nft` and `share` keys only.

Binding.title: Binding
Binding.description: A resource is one exchange account of one venue (policy 03 term 2).

Bonus.title: Bonus
Bonus.description: Promotional credit, grant, recycle, expiry, revocation, or reversal.

Cash.title: Cash
Cash.description: The settled cash view of a `notional` margin compartment (rule 46.2).

ChangesPage.title: ChangesPage
ChangesPage.description: `GET …/changes` (sync.md rule 9): litmus-state's page with the schema and resource header.

Checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
Checkpoint.description: One comparison of the records' balance with an independent source (rule 48).

Conversion.title: Conversion
Conversion.description: Canonical grouped conversion without reliable pair/order identity.

ConversionLeg.title: ConversionLeg
ConversionLeg.description: A source-preserving leg inside a canonical conversion batch.

CorrectionMark.title: CorrectionMark
CorrectionMark.description: A correction that changed a record: its content id, its kind and, when an agent's API key staged it, the agent (cex unit edits Rule 9.2).

CoverageMap.title: CoverageMap
CoverageMap.description: What a resource's exports cover (`GET …/coverage`), beside the exports its venue offers.

CreateObservation.title: CreateObservation
CreateObservation.description: Add an observation the evidence lacks; its provenance is `manual`.

CredentialError.title: CredentialError
CredentialError.description: A sanitized failure of a provider call made with stored or sent credentials; never a response body or a secret.

CredentialField.title: CredentialField
CredentialField.description: One input of a venue's credentials form.

CredentialGuide.title: CredentialGuide
CredentialGuide.description: How to create read-only API credentials at a venue, and the form that takes them.

CredentialStatus.title: CredentialStatus
CredentialStatus.description: `GET …/credentials` (rule 16 row 19; policy 02 access rule 15): never the credential itself.

CredentialTest.title: CredentialTest
CredentialTest.description: `POST …/credentials/test` (rule 16 row 20): one provider call with the credentials sent; nothing is stored.

CredentialsRequest.title: CredentialsRequest
CredentialsRequest.description:
A venue's API credentials; write-only, never echoed.

Which fields a venue takes is in `GET /venues` (Bitget: all three; Bit2Me: key and secret).

CryptoDeposit.title: CryptoDeposit
CryptoDeposit.description: Inflow from depositing a crypto asset into an account.

CryptoTransferDetail.title: CryptoTransferDetail
CryptoTransferDetail.description: `cex.crypto_deposit`, `cex.crypto_withdrawal`: display facts; the chain hash is `reference`.

CryptoWithdrawal.title: CryptoWithdrawal
CryptoWithdrawal.description: Outflow from withdrawing a crypto asset from an account.

EditPage.title: EditPage
EditPage.description: `GET …/edits`: the active set (applied, not withdrawn), or every edit with `all`, oldest first (rules 7.3.3, 15).

EditResolve.title: EditResolve
EditResolve.description: An edit whose application clears the item (rule 50.2).

EditWithdrawal.title: EditWithdrawal
EditWithdrawal.description: The withdrawal of an applied edit: staged by `DELETE …/edits/{e}`, applied by the next sync (rule 7.3.2).

EvidenceChange.title: EvidenceChange
EvidenceChange.description: An evidence entry added to or retired from the closure after `since`.

EvidenceFragment.title: EvidenceFragment
EvidenceFragment.description: The part of an evidence object a locator points at (rule 13.2).

EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef
EvidenceRef.description: One evidence object a record derives from (rule 27).

ExportCoverage.title: ExportCoverage
ExportCoverage.description:
One export a resource's files are of: the files, and the periods their rows span (cex unit verification Rule 9.2).

It reports no gap and no verdict: holes show up as failed checkpoints.

ExportGuide.title: ExportGuide
ExportGuide.description: One export a venue offers and how to download it: a suggestion, never a requirement (cex unit venue specs Rule 7.2).

FeeLeg.title: FeeLeg
FeeLeg.description: A fee leg of an event.

FiatConversion.title: FiatConversion
FiatConversion.description: Crypto balance change caused by an external fiat buy or sell.

FiatConversionDetail.title: FiatConversionDetail
FiatConversionDetail.description: `cex.fiat_conversion`: how the fiat side was paid.

FiatDeposit.title: FiatDeposit
FiatDeposit.description: Inflow from depositing a fiat asset into an account.

FiatWithdrawal.title: FiatWithdrawal
FiatWithdrawal.description: Outflow from withdrawing a fiat asset from an account.

Funding.title: Funding
Funding.description: Funding received or paid for a perpetual contract position.

FutureOrder.title: FutureOrder
FutureOrder.description: A futures or perpetual order that can contextualize fill-level trades.

FuturePositionSummary.title: FuturePositionSummary
FuturePositionSummary.description: Aggregate futures position evidence without direct ledger impact.

FutureTrade.title: FutureTrade
FutureTrade.description: A futures or perpetual fill that changes derivative exposure.

GuideLink.title: GuideLink
GuideLink.description: A link shown beside a guide.

Instrument.title: Instrument
Instrument.description: A perpetual as the catalogue currently resolves it; attached at read, never stored (rule 34).

Interest.title: Interest
Interest.description: Interest charged on a margin loan (cex unit records Rule 11.2); never a trading fee.

InternalTransfer.title: InternalTransfer
InternalTransfer.description: Movement between compartments inside the current venue account scope.

JobAccepted.title: JobAccepted

JobActor.title: JobActor

JobError.title: JobError

MergeObservations.title: MergeObservations

ObservationDetail.title: ObservationDetail
ObservationDetail.description: Informational kinds and `cex.unknown`: the canonical observation.

OpaqueBalance.title: OpaqueBalance
OpaqueBalance.description: Balance of one asset of an opaque compartment at its checkpoint.

OpaqueCompartment.title: OpaqueCompartment

PatchObservation.title: PatchObservation

PayloadChange.title: PayloadChange
PayloadChange.description: A payload written after `since`, as it is now.

Period.title: Period

Position.title: Position

Problem.title: Problem

RealizedPnl.title: RealizedPnl
RealizedPnl.description: A source-provided realized PnL settlement observation.

RecordChange.title: RecordChange
RecordChange.description: A record written after `since`, as it is now: its stored body is the record.

ResourceCreate.title: ResourceCreate

ResourcePage.title: ResourcePage

RouteResolve.title: RouteResolve
RouteResolve.description: A route whose call clears the item (rule 50.2); never a command line.

SkipRecord.title: SkipRecord

SkipSource.title: SkipSource
SkipSource.description: Drop every observation of one evidence file.

SnapshotState.title: SnapshotState

SpotOrder.title: SpotOrder
SpotOrder.description: A spot order (executed or not) for an asset pair, with an optional fee.

SpotTrade.title: SpotTrade
SpotTrade.description: An exchange of an asset for another, with an optional fee.

SyncRequest.title: SyncRequest

TradeLeg.title: TradeLeg
TradeLeg.description: A source balance leg that can support a trade or conversion batch.

Transfer.title: Transfer

UnknownObservation.title: UnknownObservation
UnknownObservation.description: A source observation whose economic meaning is intentionally unclassified.

UploadDetection.title: UploadDetection
UploadDetection.description: What an upload was detected as when `POST …/uploads` stored it, before any sync.

UploadResult.title: UploadResult

UploadedFile.title: UploadedFile

VenueGuide.title: VenueGuide

VenueList.title: VenueList
VenueList.description: Every supported venue's guide, by id (cex unit venue specs Rule 7.1).
